messages:
Zara: Quick thread \u2014 I pulled the last 4 months of postmortems and surfaced repeating patterns. Want a small focused sprint to close the highest-value follow-ups. Link: https://redwood.internal/report/recurrence-qtr

Ethan: what are the top patterns?

Zara: top 4: 1) downstream rate-limit bursts -> queued requests, 2) autoscaler config drift, 3) overlapping canaries causing double-serving, 4) cache eviction storms after GC. Estimated monthly infra + ops cost high for #1 and #4.

Mimi: Agree prioritize #1 first. Small mitigation then automation.

Zara: Proposed tiny scope per item (goal: ship a mitigation PR in <=10d):
- #1: per-host shed + immediate alert + simple dashboard. Owner: Ethan. ETA: 2026-06-02.
- #2: CI lint + nightly diff job to detect drift. Owner: Mimi. ETA: 2026-05-28.
- #3: preflight check to prevent overlapping active model IDs + runbook line. Owner: Zara. ETA: 2026-06-04.
- #4: TTL jitter + soft-evict bump + perf check. Owner: Ethan (partner with infra). ETA: 2026-06-07.

Ethan: I'll take #1 and #4. Question on #1: start host-local token bucket, then evaluate global quota later?

Zara: yes host-local first, then global quota as follow-up if needed. Keep changes minimal.

Mimi: I'll open the lint PR today and add a nightly job to create a failing check if drift detected.

PagerBot: INC-FOLLOWUP-2026-1502 created and assigned -> Ethan, Mimi, Zara. Due 2026-06-10.

Ethan: Blocker: need a staging harness to mimic downstream throttles. Opening INF-5018 and cc'ing infra.

Mimi: I'll add a "regression?" column and "est monthly cost" in the tracker so PMs can prioritize. Postmortems that need updates will be tagged followup/pending.

Zara: Scheduling a 25m monthly sync to review the tracker and status. First session 2026-05-21 11:00 PT. Invite incoming.

Ethan: I'll link PRs and tickets in the follow-up ticket as I go.

Mimi: ack.

Zara: Closing this thread: owners please update tracker by your ETA and post ticket IDs if blocked. I'll summarize to #eng-weekly after first sprint.

Ethan: ack :thumbsup:

PagerBot: /remind #incidents to review recurrence tracker every month on the third Thursday at 09:00.
